incidents.name: StepHeroNFTs self-referral claimReferral()
incidents.notes: claimReferral(address) pays out referral commission accrued from the caller's own buyAsset() purchases with no check that the referral was independent, so a flash-loaned 1000 BNB self-referred purchase could be claimed back repeatedly.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x9823E10A0bF6F64F59964bE1A7f83090bf5728aB created 2021-08-31T08:03:50Z by 0x7c1620dabfac63ba40ae2bb453dd5d5f65d19102, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xfb1cc1548d039f14b02cff9ae86757edd2cdb8a5; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 137.9 BNB x $651.91/BNB at the incident timestamp 1740111790 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $89,898.
